name: paperless-ngx
description: A community-supported supercharged document management system: scan, index and archive all your documents
one_liner: Scans and files away all your paper documents into a searchable digital cabinet, so you can throw out the filing cabinet and still find anything in seconds.
buyer: A small law firm's office manager or a solo accountant still buried in physical invoices, contracts, and receipts.
business_use_cases: A small accounting practice scans every client receipt and invoice on arrival so tax season searches take seconds instead of hours of physical filing.
A local law firm digitizes decades of paper case files into a searchable, tagged archive that any paralegal can query instantly.
A property management company runs it self-hosted to keep leases, inspection reports, and maintenance receipts in one searchable place for compliance.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'digitize your office' as a one-time setup-and-migration service for small firms still on paper.
Host and maintain it for non-technical small businesses who don't want to self-host, charging a monthly hosting fee.

steal_this: Set up a hosted instance for one local small business this weekend, scan their backlog of receipts, and bill them a flat monthly fee to keep it running.
